task: Guard every reserved-vs-real-neighbour gap with link-time asserts, make the manifest refuse a negative free tail, prove the guards fire, and correct the stale tail figures in the documentation.

defect.class: A MEMORY area is declared larger than the first real neighbour above it, so ld65's own overflow check cannot fire until foreign memory has already been overwritten.

instances.guarded_by_before: src/main.s:1311 and src/main.s:11406, both against the area

instances.note: tail shared between two link units (linked C extension + main-linked LIGHT_CODE/HEAVY_CODE); no linker symbol can see the composite. scripts/build.mjs:1134 already refuses it.

defect.already_caused: A 3-byte inline insert assembled cleanly, ran ENTITY_CODE past $9D5D and crashed at runtime on 2-contact-debris-fire0 frame 61.

guards.message: ENTITY_CODE reaches the DIRECTOR_C_PRE record at $9D5E
PICKUP_CODE reaches the end of its $8776-$8B66 window
DIRECTOR_ABI reaches the PICKUP_CODE window at $8776
DIRECTOR_C_LOW reaches the HYBRID_C_EXT window at $8C7D

symbol_placement_note: __DIRECTOR_ABI_RAM_LAST__ and __DIRECTOR_C_LOW_RAM_LAST__ are NOT in build/void-strike-65.lbl: they exist only in build/encounter-director.lbl, a separate ld65 link. src/main.s cannot import them, so those two asserts went into src/hybrid/c-asm-abi.s, the only hand-written ca65 source in that link (alongside the existing HYBRID_C_ARENA asserts). No substitute symbol was invented.
semantics: __<AREA>_RAM_LAST__ is the address AFTER the last byte used in the memory area, so the comparison is against the neighbour's first byte and a 0-byte tail still passes.

proof.method: Temporary .res 4 filler added to the segment, npm run build:candidate -- --quiet, then removed.
